summary: Postinstall beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded external endpoint
details: The package's postinstall lifecycle script collects installer host identifiers (hostname, platform, architecture, Node version, package/lifecycle name, timestamp) and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded endpoint https://wxc97jnc.instances.poc.jchunt.top/ngsw-config on npm install, with no consent, documentation, or opt-out. The package name shadows Angular's legitimate ngsw-config tooling, matching a dependency-confusion canary pattern in which internal build systems that misresolve the name automatically report identifying metadata to the operator of the poc.jchunt.top host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
